notes.title: Patch for Accessibility
notes.content:
This won't affect many people, but on request for accessibility, I've added a setting to allow playing the game with just the left and right mouse button. 
It'll be a bit of a challenge to play some of the levels like this, but if anyone is up to it, the game now supports it.
